finding: Frozen SQLite backup reads produced four unmanifested WAL/SHM sidecars, so the restore set was neither closed nor immutable.

finding: Windows git archive ZIP was path-complete but export-time text conversion changed 391 of 397 Git blob byte identities.

finding: Secret-values-not-copied was asserted from implementation shape but lacked an exhaustive non-emitting comparison against all R0 artifacts.

source: R1 independent verifier round 1 and root reproduction
finding: An untrusted adapter can relabel and rehash TEMP-only reference evidence as PRODUCT_LIVE and REAL_EXTERNAL_EFFECT, self-assert distinct actor/verifier identities and outcome booleans, and receive all-ten product PASS without any external target, effect, provider, or independent observation.
repair: make proof scope evaluator-owned and require PRODUCT_LIVE claims to be bound to evaluator-controlled independent observation of the actual canonical target, challenge nonce, before/after state, effect receipt, idempotency identity, and separate verifier context; run-root files may only be evidence copies
regression: a relabeled-and-rehashed TEMP-only reference response with self-asserted identities must deterministically FAIL with an untrusted-live-proof finding while the canonical reference remains HARNESS_SELF_TEST_ONLY

finding: BLOCKED, NOT_TESTED, and WAITING are accepted as bare adapter status words with unchanged PASS evidence and no required reason, dependency, wait event, resume condition, or named unexecuted criteria.
repair: extend the protocol and evaluator with status-specific reason codes and evidence: BLOCKED identifies an unavailable external dependency, WAITING binds a durable wait event and resume condition, NOT_TESTED names unexecuted criteria, and implementation or protocol failure remains FAIL
regression: blind flips of a reference journey to BLOCKED, NOT_TESTED, or WAITING must each deterministically FAIL validation unless the required status-specific evidence is present

finding: The fresh DeepSeek repair builder remained running without a mandatory-reading checkpoint, file change, or response to two bounded status requests and was interrupted before replacement to preserve single-writer ownership; the internal cause is unknown.

regression: fresh verifier must confirm the failed-attempt record and original repair package are hash-bound, no partial output was reused, and only the successful replacement owns repair deliverables
